_comment: Tenderly alert configuration for Resurgence Protocol. Import via Tenderly dashboard or CLI.

alerts.name: Large Stake Event
alerts.description: Someone stakes more than 1M tokens in a single transaction

alerts.name: Large Unstake Event
alerts.description: Someone unstakes more than 1M tokens — possible exit or pool drain

alerts.name: Pool Paused
alerts.description: A staking pool has been paused — requires immediate investigation

alerts.name: Contract Upgrade
alerts.description: A UUPS proxy has been upgraded — verify this was authorized by governance

alerts.name: Governance Proposal Created
alerts.description: A new governance proposal has been submitted

alerts.name: Governance Proposal Executed
alerts.description: A governance proposal has been executed via Timelock

alerts.name: Reward Rate Changed
alerts.description: Pool reward rate has been updated by governance

alerts.name: RESURGE Mint Approaching Cap
alerts.description: Total RESURGE minted is within 5% of maxMintSupply

alerts.name: Failed Transaction — Reentrancy Attempt
alerts.description: A transaction reverted with ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall — possible attack attempt
